test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What annual installment will discharge a debt of Rs. 3,658 due in four years at 12% simple interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (Debt) = Rs. 3,658

Time (T) = 4 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 12%

**Formula Used:**

Installment = (100 × P) / [100 × T + R × T × (T – 1) / 2]

**Calculation:**

Installment = (100 × 3,658) / [100 × 4 + 12 × 4 × (4 – 1) / 2]

⇒ Installment = (100 × 3,658) / [400 + 12 × 4 × 3 / 2]

⇒ Installment = (100 × 3,658) / [400 + 72]

⇒ Installment = (100 × 3,658) / 472

⇒ Installment = 100 × (3,658 / 472)

⇒ Installment = 100 × 7.75

⇒ Installment = 775

**∴ The annual installment required to discharge the debt is ₹775.**
